stimulus.alt: Annotated controlled SOP and work-order diagram highlighting document identity and revision status, task scope, prerequisites, specific room or material assignment, acceptance criteria, required records, and escalation points.
stimulus.caption: Use the document-control cues in the diagram to decide which instruction governs the work.

stem: Two SOP copies are available for the same task, but only one is marked current and effective. Which should the technician use?
choices: The copy with more handwritten notes
Whichever version the technician remembers using last
The older copy if it is shorter
rationale: Controlled work should use the current authorized instruction, not memory, convenience, or uncontrolled annotations.
